    • fromTemplate

      public T fromTemplate(String html, TemplateProcessor template)
      Parses the provided HTML template into this interface with variable substitution.

      Example usage:

      builder.fromTemplate("""
    <p>Hello, {{$playerName}}!</p>
    <p>Score: {{$score|0}}</p>
    """, new TemplateProcessor()
        .setVariable("playerName", player.getName())
        .setVariable("score", 1500));
      Parameters:
      html - The HTML template with {{$variable}} placeholders
      template - The template processor with variables set
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining

    • addEventListener

      public <V> T addEventListener(String id, com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.interface_.CustomUIEventBindingType type, Class<V> valueClass, Consumer<V> callback)
      Adds an event listener to an element by its ID. Note: This only works for elements created using the builder API or via HYUIML (.fromHtml). It does not work for elements defined in a .ui file loaded via .fromFile.
      Type Parameters:
      V - The type of the value.
      Parameters:
      id - The ID of the element.
      type - The type of event to listen for.
      valueClass - The class of the value associated with the event.
      callback - The callback to execute when the event occurs.
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining.
